description: This PHP class `PostTransformer` is part of the Goteo project and is responsible for transforming blog post models into a specific format, providing URLs and information for API and frontend display.

classes.name: PostTransformer
classes.description: A transformer class for blog post models that provides URLs, metadata, and actions related to posts.

methods.name: getApiProperty
methods.description: Returns the API URL for modifying a specific property of the post.

methods.name: getPublish
methods.description: Retrieves the publication status of the post.

methods.name: getSlug
methods.description: Retrieves the slug of the post.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns formatted HTML with date, author, and subtitle information.

methods.name: getAuthor
methods.description: Retrieves the author's name or 'Unknown' if not available.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Provides action URLs such as edit, translate, and preview based on user permissions.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns a URL link to the blog post, for public or other types.
